Forma con lista fija ejecutada en DuckDB: A fixed value list was executed in DuckDB. Not all Snowflake dynamic options were verified.
Se verificó la forma básica; las variant: The basic form was verified; INCLUDE/EXCLUDE NULLS variants and type restrictions require separate verification.
Evalúa una subconsulta correlacionada co: Evaluates a subquery correlated with earlier FROM sources.
La subconsulta probada funciona en DuckD: The tested subquery works in DuckDB. This does not enable TABLE(FLATTEN(...)) or every Snowflake table function.
Forma básica ejecutada en DuckDB; las re: Basic form executed in DuckDB; type and NULL rules follow the engine.
Genera subtotales jerárquicos y un total: Produces hierarchical subtotals and a grand total.
Aplica cálculos sobre ventanas de filas: Applies calculations over row windows without grouping the output.
LAG, LEAD, RANK, DENSE_RANK, FIRST_VALUE: LAG, LEAD, RANK, DENSE_RANK, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, NTILE, CUME_DIST, PERCENT_RANK and NTH_VALUE were executed. They already appear in the native catalog; catalog signatures do not explain optional arguments or guarantee every Snowflake frame.
Evalúa expresiones condicionales, conver: Evaluates conditional expressions, casts and SQL predicates.
Las formas mostradas se delegan a DuckDB: The shown forms are delegated to DuckDB and were executed. SQL CASE expressions differ from procedural CASE. Coercions and errors follow the engine.
Une cada fila con la coincidencia tempor: Joins each row to its closest temporal match using engine syntax.
La forma DuckDB mostrada funciona. La si: The shown DuckDB form works. Snowflake ASOF JOIN ... MATCH_CONDITION(...) ON ... fails: MATCH_CONDITION is not adapted.
Usa una variable procedural como nombre: Uses a procedural variable as a dynamic object name.
Sólo dentro de procedimientos, con un id: Only inside procedures, with a validated simple identifier. Qualified or quoted names and general Snowflake IDENTIFIER with literals or session variables are unsupported. Procedural temporary tables are cleaned up when the invocation ends.
Consulta filas afectadas y detalles del: Reads affected row counts and error details inside the procedural interpreter.
SQLROWCOUNT inicia en 0, se actualiza tr: SQLROWCOUNT starts at 0, updates after non-query statements and survives SELECT or an error. Current Snowflake uses NULL after non-DML with bundle 2025_01 enabled. SQLCODE=-1 and SQLSTATE=XX000 are generic; SQLERRM contains the local error. Only top-level EXCEPTION WHEN OTHER; no dedicated SQLFOUND/SQLNOTFOUND.
Recibe valores posicionales enviados por: Receives positional values submitted by the client through the API.
No ejecutar el ejemplo sin enviar bindin: Do not run the example without supplying bindings. :1/:2 and ? use textual substitution; there is no complete placeholder parser and literals/comments may be affected. They differ from session $name and procedural :name variables.
DISTINCT, EXCLUDE, REPLACE y RENAME se e: DISTINCT, EXCLUDE, REPLACE and RENAME ran in simple forms. TOP 1 fails. FROM DUAL is only removed at the end: SELECT 1 FROM DUAL works while SELECT 1 FROM DUAL; fails.
WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION A: WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM c WHERE n<3) SELECT * FROM c ran and returned 1, 2, 3. This verifies that form, not every recursive use.
OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY se: OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY ran. SELECT TOP 1 fails; it is not translated to LIMIT.
UNION BY NAME funciona en la forma simpl: UNION BY NAME works in the tested simple form. Snowflake MINUS fails; use EXCEPT in verified forms.
Las variantes con FROM/USING funcionan e: FROM/USING variants work in DuckDB. With logical context, WHERE table_name.id can fail after object rewriting. Use an explicit AS t alias and WHERE t.id: both aliased forms were executed.
Sólo USE ROLE tiene implementación SQL e: Only USE ROLE has an explicit SQL implementation. USE DATABASE, USE SCHEMA and USE WAREHOUSE fail. Database, schema and warehouse are selected through the UI or API context; that does not enable those SQL commands.
Selecciona el rol activo de la sesión au: Selects the active role of the authenticated session.
DATABASE admite USAGE; SCHEMA admite USA: DATABASE accepts USAGE; SCHEMA accepts USAGE and CREATE TABLE; TABLE accepts SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE; WAREHOUSE accepts USAGE and OPERATE. SHOW GRANTS without a target fails. Output uses local columns; no ALL PRIVILEGES or future grants.
CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE/SCHEMA se rec: CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE/SCHEMA is rejected. CASCADE and RESTRICT are accepted as text but do not implement distinct policies; object and metadata cleanup is local and does not equal Snowflake.
Estas variantes ALTER se ejecutaron con: These ALTER variants ran with logical context. Complete synchronization of every change with the catalog was not verified; full Snowflake ALTER TABLE support is not claimed.
CREATE USER requiere PASSWORD. ALTER USE: CREATE USER requires PASSWORD. ALTER USER SET accepts the shown properties individually or combined. The complete Snowflake identity property set is not implemented.
Requiere una sesión activa. Nombres sin: Requires an active session. Names are case insensitive; one scalar per SET and one name per UNSET. The local value text limit is 16 KiB. SHOW VARIABLES is not connected to the session variable map; SET does not configure Snowflake parameters.
SHOW TABLES, SHOW DATABASES y SHOW SCHEM: SHOW TABLES, SHOW DATABASES and SHOW SCHEMAS without a dedicated processor use DuckDB: they may expose _metadata_* tables and physical names such as memory/main. SHOW TABLES LIKE fails. DESCRIBE TABLE and DESC TABLE ran; DESCRIBE SCHEMA fails.
SHOW USER FUNCTIONS es un alias reconoci: SHOW USER FUNCTIONS is a recognized alias of SHOW FUNCTIONS. It only lists local UDFs; browse the native catalog separately.
METADATA$ACTION siempre es INSERT; METAD: METADATA$ACTION is always INSERT; METADATA$ISUPDATE is always FALSE; METADATA$ROW_ID derives from engine rowid. SELECT does not consume. Successful DML/CTAS advances the offset; execution failure does not. APPEND_ONLY = FALSE is rejected.
Las tablas temporales creadas en el inté: Temporary tables created inside the interpreter are renamed per invocation and cleaned up on completion or failure. Parameters and return types do not enforce a complete Snowflake signature.
IDENTIFIER(:variable), SQLROWCOUNT y las: IDENTIFIER(:variable), SQLROWCOUNT and exception variables have dedicated entries. :variable binds procedural SQL; it is not a positional binding or a session $name variable.
La adaptación se limita a NUMBER en colu: Adaptation is limited to NUMBER in CREATE TABLE columns. It does not extend to CAST, ALTER or UDF arguments. Precision 1..38; scale 0..min(precision,37). Native NUMERIC/DECIMAL may use different defaults.
DDL probado: VARIANT fue aceptado en est: Tested DDL: VARIANT was accepted in this engine version. OBJECT, ARRAY without an element type, TIMESTAMP_NTZ, TIMESTAMP_LTZ, TIMESTAMP_TZ and GEOGRAPHY failed. Protocol type mapping describes results, not an input grammar.
Instalá un entorno local con consola web: Install a local environment with a web console, DuckDB and the documented SQL subset. Docker includes the console; source builds must build it first.
Requisito: Docker con contenedores Linux: Requirement: Docker with Linux containers. Published images support AMD64 and ARM64; macOS and Windows use Docker Desktop. Standalone binaries are not published.
Abrí http://localhost:8080. La base de d: Open http://localhost:8080. This first example keeps the database in memory and loses it when the process stops. Use the next example to preserve data and stage files.
El volumen guarda la base y los archivos: The volume stores the database and stage files. Stopping or removing the container does not delete the volume. Deleting the volume deletes the data.
En un catálogo de identidad vacío se cre: An empty identity catalog creates ADMIN with password admin and role ACCOUNTADMIN. An existing catalog is not reset at startup. These demonstration credentials are for local learning.
Entrá a la consola, seleccioná base TEST: Sign in to the console and select database TEST_DB, schema PUBLIC and warehouse COMPUTE_WH in the worksheet controls. Context is configured through the UI; USE DATABASE, USE SCHEMA and USE WAREHOUSE are not implemented as SQL.
Requisitos de esta revisión: Git, Go 1.2: Requirements for this revision: Git, Go 1.26.6 or later, a C/C++ compiler for CGO and Node.js 24.20.0 (see _web/.nvmrc). On macOS install Xcode Command Line Tools; on Linux use your distribution build tools. On Windows use WSL2 or Docker.
Ejecutá los comandos en una terminal POS: Run these commands in a POSIX terminal. Building the frontend before the binary embeds the web console. A go build without that step does not produce the same console.
Para parar Docker usá docker stop con el: To stop Docker use docker stop with the container name. To update, stop and remove only the container, pull the image and repeat the persistent command with the same volume. Back up the data while the emulator is stopped before updating.
latest puede cambiar. Para entornos repr: latest can change. For reproducible environments choose a published tag from GitHub Releases. This reference describes the indicated source revision; an older image may provide fewer features.
Si el puerto 8080 está ocupado, usá -p 1: If port 8080 is busy, use -p 127.0.0.1:9090:8080 with Docker and open http://localhost:9090. For a local build use PORT=9090. A CGO error requires checking the native compiler; a missing console requires rebuilding the frontend and then the binary.
La autenticación y los permisos son un s: Authentication and permissions are a subset for local study. Do not use the emulator as a production security boundary.
TOP, MINUS, MATCH_CONDITION, SAMPLE/TABL: TOP, MINUS, MATCH_CONDITION, SAMPLE/TABLESAMPLE with Snowflake percentage syntax, AT/CHANGES, CLONE, CREATE TABLE LIKE and EXECUTE IMMEDIATE failed in the tested forms. Dedicated support is not claimed for CONNECT BY, MATCH_RECOGNIZE, RESAMPLE, SEMANTIC_VIEW, FOR UPDATE, loops, cursors or RAISE.
CURRENT_DATABASE() y CURRENT_SCHEMA() de: CURRENT_DATABASE() and CURRENT_SCHEMA() return physical DuckDB context. CURRENT_USER without parentheses may return duckdb; use CURRENT_USER() and CURRENT_ROLE() for the emulator session. CURRENT_WAREHOUSE(), CURRENT_SESSION() and LAST_QUERY_ID() are not implemented.
128 ejecuciones exploratorias adicionale: 128 additional exploratory executions checked concrete forms with and without logical context. They include repeated queries and intentional failures; they are not 128 distinct capabilities or a complete Snowflake compatibility test.
Los 1009 registros incluyen 947 nombres: The 1009 records include 947 native names, 15 emulator functions and 47 syntax and command references.
Las pruebas cubren CTE simples, encadena: Tests cover simple and chained CTEs and CTAS. A simple recursive CTE also ran; equivalence for all Snowflake recursive forms is not claimed.
Los 1009 registros incluyen 947 nombres: These 1009 entries include 947 native names, 15 emulator functions and 47 syntax and command references. Names overlap between layers; this is not a count of Snowflake-compatible functions.
Entrá a la consola con ADMIN/admin y cre: Sign in to the console with ADMIN/admin and create the warehouse using the shown command. Then select database TEST_DB, schema PUBLIC and warehouse COMPUTE_WH in the worksheet controls. Context is configured through the UI; USE DATABASE, USE SCHEMA and USE WAREHOUSE are not implemented as SQL.
Con el contexto seleccionado, ejecutá es: After selecting the context, run this query to verify the session and SQL translation.
Tamaños admitidos: X-SMALL, SMALL, MEDIU: Accepted sizes: X-SMALL, SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE, X-LARGE, 2X-LARGE, 3X-LARGE, 4X-LARGE, 5X-LARGE and 6X-LARGE. Defaults: X-SMALL, AUTO_RESUME=TRUE, AUTO_SUSPEND=600 seconds. Options are separated by spaces; unknown options are rejected.
Abrí http://localhost:8080. Este comando: Open http://localhost:8080. This command uses an in-memory database: tables, users and metadata are lost when the process stops. The volume preserves stage files in /data/stages, but mounting /data alone does not make the database persistent.
Ejecutá una sola alternativa Docker a la: Run only one Docker alternative at a time. If another container already uses port 8080, stop it before starting a second one. Ctrl+C stops this foreground example; --rm removes the exited container and preserves the volume.
Limitación comprobada en v0.7.0: una ins: Verified v0.7.0 limitation: an installation using DB_PATH may start and then fail after docker stop and a restart with Failure while replaying WAL file. This was reproduced with a fresh volume. This configuration shows how to select persistent storage, but does not guarantee a successful restart in this version. For experiments without this problem, use the in-memory alternative.
docker run -d devuelve el ID del contene: docker run -d returns the container ID before the server is ready; it does not confirm that it remains running. Check docker ps -a and docker logs if /health does not respond.
La limitación WAL de v0.7.0 también afec: The v0.7.0 WAL limitation also affects restarting a persistent installation during an upgrade. Preserve the original volume and its backup; do not delete WAL files to force startup, because they may contain changes not yet stored in the database.
Si curl devuelve Failed to connect, comp: If curl reports Failed to connect, check the container state and logs using the commands below. If it is still running and starting, wait for Starting Snowflake Emulator and retry /health. If its state is Exited, waiting or changing the port does not resolve the process failure.
Failed to open database con Failure whil: Failed to open database with Failure while replaying WAL file means DuckDB failed to recover the persistent database. This is not a port problem. Preserve both the .db and .wal files and the original volume for recovery investigation. In-memory mode avoids opening those files, but does not recover their data.
